trailhead.label: Max Valier observatory, Obergummer (official start; Gasthaus Unteregger beside it)

cautions: About 230 m on and across the provincial road (SP132).
About 3.8 km on quiet asphalt farm roads (Via Learn, Via Obergummer) and village streets.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
